## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and its effect.

## Reproduction

List the steps, revision, configuration, and relevant logs. Remove credentials
and private financial records.

## Expected behavior

Describe what should happen.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A check reproduces the problem and passes with the fix.

## Scope and links

List exclusions, related issues, and PRs.
